svg.title: Pendulum phase portrait
svg.desc: Phase portrait of the pendulum, angle theta horizontal and angular velocity v vertical. Closed orbits circle stable centers (filled dots) at theta = 0 and plus or minus 2 pi; separatrices cross at saddle points (open circles) at plus or minus pi; above and below, wavy open curves are rotations moving right on top and left on the bottom. Arrows show the clockwise direction of flow.
